title: snapshot of a run before the supervisor signals its conductor
description: Evidence written to <run>/supervisor/snapshot-<UTC>.json before any signal: the class of health, what `status --json` prints, the heartbeat and lease documents, the last 50 lines of the journal and the processes of the conductor and of the role groups. Redacted like the status display.

health.description: The result of health.classify at that time.

heartbeat.description: heartbeat.json as it was, null when there was none.

lease.description: lease.json as it was, null when there was none.

processes.description: The conductor with its descendants and every process of the role groups of process.json.

cpu_s.description: CPU seconds used so far (user + system).

args.description: Command line, at most 200 characters, redacted.
